'''''CST-blue'' group''' was a group of four [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-aligned [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Organarms]] at some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

They were most likely manufactured there, as they were being transferred from the station, which scanners revealed to have a cargo of "shuttles," to transport containers by [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s when they were destroyed.
